visualCharacteristics.purpose: short list of recent articles or press releases linking to their detail pages
visualCharacteristics.description: Vertical list: thumbnail (~3/12 column, linked to the detail page) beside a linked H3 title, date, and teaser ending in a small bold uppercase underlined READ MORE link with a chevron; stacks on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: one row per item (newest first); cell 1 = thumbnail image (optionally wrapped in a link to the detail page); cell 2 = H3 with the title linked to the detail page, a date paragraph, a teaser paragraph ending with a READ MORE link to the same page
contentPattern.notes: An unlinked thumbnail is linked to the title link by the block. The READ MORE link gets the accessible name "Read more about <title>". The H2 above and the VIEW ALL button below stay default content.

suitableFor: any dated list of linked teasers with a thumbnail
